## Reliable AI Actions everywhere

- The menu-bar AI Actions panel now opens, closes, and reopens consistently from both the Hibiscus icon and its global shortcut.
- Transformations can be created reliably and assigned their own global shortcuts.
- AI results replace editable selections in place. For read-only text, Hibiscus can copy the result, show it in a result window, or save it as a new note.
- Activity opens on the newest days, Settings copy is shorter, and all AI provider marks—including Claude—use one consistent system tint.
